actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.description: Custom action in Google Speech to Text (Custom)
actions.help: Build your own Google Speech to Text action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized under your Google Speech to Text connection OAuth scopes: Scopes View and manage your data across Google Cloud Platform services

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: speech_to_text
actions.title: Convert short speech to text
actions.description: Convert short speech to text transcript
actions.help: This action uses speech recognition to transcribe a short audio file (less than 1 minute) into text transcript.

input.name: content
input.label: Audio content
input.hint: The content of the audio file containing the speech.

input.name: languageCode
input.label: Language
input.hint: Language code of the audio file (e.g. en-US ). For all supported language codes, please refer to here .

input.name: encoding
input.label: Encoding
input.hint: Encoding of the audio file. Learn more

input.name: sampleRateHertz
input.label: Sample rate in Hertz
input.hint: Sample rate of the audio file. Valid value range is 8000-48000 . Usual optimal rate is 16,000. For valid inputs based on encoding type, please refer to here .

input.name: enableWordTimeOffsets
input.label: Enable word time offsets
input.hint: If true , the result includes a list of words and the start and end time offsets (timestamps) for those words. Default is false .
